worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{s}\,r & =|\,r\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =10cos\,(\frac{2\pi }{3}) \\  & =10\cdot (-\frac{1}{2}) \\  & =-5.\end{aligned}
$$
